name: Galaxy Note 20

images.credit: Marcusph, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra (indirect), Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 3 (indirect), Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra (direct)

Network.SIM: nanoSIM, eSIM, Single SIM or Hybrid Dual SIM in dual stand-by

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 10 with One UI 2.5, Final: Android 13 with One UI 5.1
Platform.Chipset: Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific (Except East Asia), and Brazil: Samsung Exynos 990, East Asia (Greater China, South Korea, Japan), North America and Latin America (Except Brazil): Qualcomm Snapdragon 865+
Platform.CPU: Exynos:, Octa-core (2x2.73 GHz Mongoose M5 & 2x2.50 GHz Cortex-A76 & 4x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55, Snapdragon:, Octa-core (1x3.09 GHz Kryo 585 & 3x2.42 GHz Kryo 585 & 4x1.8 GHz Kryo 585)

Memory.Card slot: Note 20: None, Note 20 Ultra: microSDXC, expandable up to 1 TB

Display.Display: Note 20:, 6.7 in Super AMOLED Plus capacitive touchscreen, 1080p (2.5 MP), (393 Pixel density, ppi), 60 Hz refresh rate, Gorilla Glass 5, Note 20 Ultra:, 6.9 in Dynamic AMOLED 2X capacitive touchscreen, 1440p, (495 ppi), 120 Hz refresh rate on 1080p resolution, Gorilla Glass Victus, Both: 16M colours, HDR10+

Cameras.Rear camera: Note 20:, 12 MP, ƒ/1.8, 26 mm, 1/1.76", 1.8 μm (wide) + 64 MP, ƒ/2.0, 1/1.72", 0.8 μm (telephoto) + 12 MP, ƒ/2.2, 13 mm, 1/2.55", 1.4 μm (ultrawide), Dual Pixel Autofocus#Phase detection, PDAF, 3× optical zoom, 30× hybrid zoom (optical zoom, optical and digital zoom combined), Note 20 Ultra:, 108 MP, ƒ/1.8, 26 mm, 0.8 μm, 1/1.33" (wide) + 12 MP, ƒ/3.0, 103 mm, 1/3.4" (telephoto) + 12 MP, ƒ/2.2, 13 mm, 1.4 μm, 1/2.55" (ultrawide), PDAF, Laser AF, 5× Zoom lens, optical zoom, Both:, 8K@24fps, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@30/60/240fps, 720p@960fps, HDR10+, stereo sound recording, gyro-EIS & OIS, LED flash, auto-HDR, panorama
Cameras.Front camera: 10 MP, ƒ/2.2, 26 mm (wide), 1/3.2", 1.22 μm, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@30fps, Dual video call, Auto-HDR

Battery.Battery: Non-removable, Note 20: 4300 mAh, Note 20 Ultra: 4500 mAh
Battery.Charging: Supports Fast Charging at 25W, Fast Qi/PMA wireless charging, Reverse wireless charging at 4.5W, USB Power Delivery 3.0

Connectivity.Connectivity: GSM/CDMA/HSPA/EVDO/LTE/5G, WLAN, 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax, dual band, Wi-Fi Direct & Hotspot, Bluetooth 5.0, A2DP, LE & aptX, A-GPS, GLONASS, BDS & GALILEO, NFC, USB 3.2, Type-C 1.0 reversible connector, USB On-The-Go
